decision: Implement bounded reciprocal conditional optical factors for non-monotone occupations without changing the EOS or fitting strengths.
observation: Four doubly ionized stages have w_upper/w_lower > 1; the largest is 1.00000410107. Upward-only interpretation as a probability fails there.
joint_model: p_ij=min(w_i,w_j), common U in [0,1] and level i survives iff U<w_i. Up=p_ij/w_i, down=p_ij/w_j.
metadata_repair: Catalog parent_weight now records the candidate N III ground weight; old values retained as original_parent_weight. The native library already used the candidate value. No numeric EOS input changed.
